issue.title: ast_edit preview succeeds for non-existent files then force fails

steps: Call ast_edit on src/missing.ts with old_string `const a = 1;` and new_string `const a = 2;` (without force), then call it again with force: true.
expected: The first (preview) ast_edit call reports that src/missing.ts does not exist instead of returning a successful preview.
defect: The preview returns "AST validation: PASSED", 0 declarations and "NEXT STEP: Call again with force: true"; only the force call reports "File not found".

fault location.explanation: Swallows ENOENT and returns an empty string, so a missing file looks like an empty existing file to the preview; after PR #2029 the preview no longer uses this helper and gets calculateEdit's FILE_NOT_FOUND error.

Builds and validates a preview from that empty content without the file-existence check that calculateEdit performs for the apply path; PR #2029 routes the preview through calculateEdit and returns its error.

Root cause: FIXED UPSTREAM IN https://github.com/vybestack/llxprt-code/pull/2029. In v0.9.3 the ast_edit preview path reads the target through readFileContent, which turns ENOENT into an empty string, and then applies the replacement to '' and validates it, so a non-existent target yields a 'successful' preview with zero declarations and AST validation PASSED. The apply path instead uses calculateEdit, which detects !fileExists with a non-empty old_string and returns 'File not found'. Commit e88afa5 (PR #2029, 'Validate ast_edit preview replacements', written for #1755) removes the separate preview read and makes executePreview call calculateEdit and return its error, which also covers the missing-file case. The fix first ships in v0.10.0; the pinned v0.11.0 contains it, so the case is tested at v0.9.3. The issue itself was closed as NOT_PLANNED; the attribution of the fix to PR #2029 is an inference from the diff.
